decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy is closely related to the firm's care and psychosocial knowledge base, and its move from a website mention in 2023 to the home page in 2024 suggests the firm has learned how to position and develop it commercially.

Counseling for senior living fits the firm's core residential-care capabilities very well, and repeated home-page prominence indicates strong strategic fit and enough internal knowledge to refine the service further.

The retail shop is somewhat less central than direct care services but still builds on existing sheltered-workshop capabilities, and its higher visibility in 2024 implies the firm is successfully absorbing market feedback and improving it.

Meal delivery for seniors is adjacent to the firm's elderly-care activities and worth retaining for another year of learning, but because it is newer and only lightly featured on the website, uncertainty about operational fit and scalable improvement remains higher.
